latest_release.name: T3 Code v0.1.13
latest_release.body:
**v0.1.13** · 401 changes from 52 contributors

- **Workflow subjects.** Link workflow runs to an issue or pull request and find them from the item or run lists.
- **Workflow concurrency.** Limit concurrent workflow runs with named pools that queue excess work.
- **Stop devices.** Stop individual simulators and emulators or stop them all from the Device panel.
- **Copy file paths.** Copy a file or folder’s full path from the Files panel.
- **Chinese text files.** Open GBK and GB18030 files in the Files Viewer and read their changes in the Diff panel.
- **Prompt stash protection.** A full stash now keeps your existing prompts and leaves the new prompt in the composer.
- **Shared checkout protection.** Cancelling worktree setup no longer discards edits from a side chat sharing the checkout.

### Plus 380 more bug fixes and performance improvements.

detail.readme:
T3 Code

The open-source control plane for coding agents.

Download · iOS · Android · Web · Docs · Discord

T3 Code runs the coding agents on your machine and gives them one fast interface. Start a thread at your desk, then approve the next step from your phone. It works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Grok Build, Antigravity, Kiro, Pi, Muse Code, fx, and any [ACP](./docs/user/providers-acp.md) agent. If an agent is set up on your computer, T3 Code can control it. ## What you get - **Your subscriptions.** T3 Code does not resell tokens. It drives the agents you are already signed in to. - **Every agent in one place.** Change models in the middle of a thread. Let Claude hand a task to Codex. - **Desktop, web, and phone.** One server, and every client shows the same threads. There are apps for iOS and Android. - **Remote ready.** Run agents on any machine. Connect over your local network, Tailscale, or [T3 Connect](./docs/user/remote-access.md). - **Git built in.** Each thread can work in its own worktree. Review the diff, then commit, push, and open a pull request with one button. - **Fast.** Performance is a feature here. We measure it, and we treat a dropped frame as a bug. - **Open.** Source code is MIT licensed. If you don't like something, fork it under your own branding (see [Trademarks and forks](#trademarks-and-forks)). ## Install ### Desktop app [Download T3 Code](https://t3.codes/download) for macOS, Windows, or Linux. You can also use a package manager: | Platform | Command | | -------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- | | macOS | `brew install --cask t3-code` | | Windows | `winget install T3Tools.T3Code` or `scoop install extras/t3code` | | Arch Linux | `yay -S t3code-bin` | | Nix | `nix profile add github:NixOS/nixpkgs/nixos-unstable#t3code` | | Debian, Ubuntu | `.deb` from [Releases](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/releases) | ### Command line This installs the `t3` command. Run `t3` to start the server and open the web app. ```bash curl -fsSL https://t3.codes/install.sh | sh ``` On Windows, in PowerShell: ```powershell irm https://t3.codes/install.ps1 | iex ``` To try it once without an install, run `npx t3@latest`. ### Phone Get the app from the [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/t3-code-remote-claude-more/id6787819824) or [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.t3tools.t3code). Then follow [remote access](./docs/user/remote-access.md) to connect it to your computer. ### Sign in to an agent T3 Code needs one agent that is installed and signed in. For example, install [Claude Code](https://claude.com/product/claude-code) and run `claude auth login`, or install [Codex CLI](https://developers.openai.com/codex/cli) and run `codex login`. [Provider setup](./docs/user/install.md#providers) has the steps for each agent. [Install T3 Code](./docs/user/install.md) covers nightly builds, AppImage, WSL, and NixOS. ## "Wait, what are you selling me?" Nothing. We built T3 Code because we wanted the best possible development experience with agents. We were inspired by existing solutions like the Codex desktop app, Conductor, Claude Desktop and Cursor Glass, but none met our bar. We wanted something performant, remote-ready, and truly open. If we ever go the wrong direction, we want you to have everything you need to fork the source code and build the tool that you want, under your own name and branding. ## Documentation - [Install and first run](./docs/user/install.md) - [Remote access from a phone or another machine](./docs/user/remote-access.md) - [Permission modes](./docs/user/permission-modes.md) - [Source control](./docs/user/source-control.md) - [Connect outside agents over MCP](./docs/user/outside-agents.md) - [FAQ](./docs/user/faq.md) [All docs](./docs/README.md) has the full list. ## Contributing We have limited review capacity. Small, focused fixes are the most likely to be merged. Features need an approved discussion first. - Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md) before you report a bug or open a pull request. - Put feature requests in [Ideas](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/discussions/categories/ideas). - Build from source with the [development runbook](./docs/operations/00_development.md#first-checkout). The [architecture overview](./docs/internals/01_architecture.md) explains how it works. - Get help in [Discord](https://discord.gg/jn4EGJjrvv). ## License The source code in this repository is licensed under the [MIT License](./LICENSE). ## Trademarks and forks The MIT license applies **only to the source code**. It does not grant any rights to T3 Tools, Inc.'s trademarks, branding, or trade dress, including the **T3 Code** name, wordmark, logos, and application icons. If you fork, redistribute, or build on T3 Code's source code: - **Use your own branding.** Replace the T3 Code name, wordmark, logos, and application icons in any public fork, redistributed build, website, package, or app store listing. - **Be explicitly clear that your project is unofficial.** Do not use the T3 Code name, wordmark, logo, or branding in your own projects without making it unmistakably clear that your project is unofficial and not affiliated with or endorsed by T3 Tools, Inc. Using our name, wordmark, logo, or branding in a way that suggests official status or affiliation is trademark infringement and unlawful. **Any project indicating or implying that it is an official version of T3 Code when it is not will be pursued to the full extent of the law.** See [TRADEMARK.md](./TRADEMARK.md) for the full trademark and branding policy.
